commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "6bb5022e3ea8185ce10f9497c9e557df46df4b4c" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
files = [
 Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_common.h'),
 Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_core.h'),
 Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/on_off.h'),
 Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/level.h'),
]
needles = [
 'typedef struct ezb_zcl_message_info_s',
 'typedef struct ezb_zcl_set_attr_value_message_s',
 'EZB_ZCL_CORE_SET_ATTR_VALUE_CB_ID',
 'typedef void (*ezb_zcl_core_action_handler_t',
 'ezb_zcl_core_action_handler_register',
 'ON_OFF', 'LEVEL', 'server',
]
for p in files:
    lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    print('===', p, '===')
    emitted=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if any(n in line for n in needles):
            lo=max(0,i-6); hi=min(len(lines),i+20)
            if (lo,hi) in emitted: continue
            emitted.add((lo,hi))
            print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{lines[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
print('=== examples/set-attr callbacks ===')
root=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib')
for p in root.rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file() or p.suffix not in {'.c','.h','.cpp'}: continue
    try: text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    except Exception: continue
    if 'EZB_ZCL_CORE_SET_ATTR_VALUE_CB_ID' in text or 'ezb_zcl_set_attr_value_message_t' in text:
        print(p)
        for i,l in enumerate(text.splitlines()):
            if 'EZB_ZCL_CORE_SET_ATTR_VALUE_CB_ID' in l or 'ezb_zcl_set_attr_value_message_t' in l:
                ls=text.splitlines(); lo=max(0,i-5); hi=min(len(ls),i+18)
                print('\n'.join(ls[lo:hi]))
PY
